instruction: Place an order for all staplers in my amazon cart.
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The cart is modeled with representative products: two staplers and two non-staplers (adjust the product objects and the counter chain to the real cart size discovered by amazon.show_cart). Each cart item's type is learned via amazon.show_product (known-type), which is required before an item may be removed; only non-staplers can ever be removed (is-stapler products have no removing action), so cart quantities of staplers stay untouched and the ordered quantities equal the cart quantities. A discrete counter (zero, n1, n2 with succ) tracks how many non-staplers remain in the cart; amazon.place_order requires the counter to be zero, so the order can only contain staplers. The goal is therefore just (order-placed) and (task-completed), and supervisor-complete-task's precondition is exactly (order-placed). Payment card and address ids are read from amazon.show_payment_cards / amazon.show_addresses; no address is added, modified or deleted. The reference plan includes show_product for every cart item (a valid, if non-minimal, plan); an optimal planner may only inspect the non-staplers.
